=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: lines 3038-3084 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_inject_token_into_url` embeds `GH_TOKEN` in HTTPS Git URLs after per-process `http.extraHeader` authentication was removed.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in subprocess argv, `/proc/*/cmdline`, Git diagnostics, crash output, and process listings.

- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: lines 2987-2992 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_git_subprocess_env()` no longer supplies the scoped `http.extraHeader` authentication used by Git subprocesses.
  WHY: Bare Git operations that previously authenticated through the per-process header now fail against unauthenticated origins.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: lines 137-180, 569-588, 601-925 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` was removed, memory operations use bare Git commands, and `_memory_force_tick_remote_url` embeds `GH_PAT`/`GH_TOKEN` in remote URLs.
  WHY: Consumer checkouts with `persist-credentials: false` cannot initialize or update `ai-memory`, while force-tick URLs expose credentials through argv and Git output.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 152-168, 240-247, 536-716 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `is_sensitive_target_path`, `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, and `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES` were removed, allowing caller-supplied sensitive paths to be resolved and read.
  WHY: Paths such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh`, `.aws`, and credential files can be inlined into model prompts, including through symlinks.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: lines 208-216, 664-671 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase removed the model-provider broker and invokes Codex with `--sandbox danger-full-access` while provider and GitHub credentials remain in scope.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostic content can drive workspace mutation or exfiltration of `GH_TOKEN` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 105-388 (deletion of entire `model_provider_broker_*` family) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `model_provider_broker_*` lifecycle, preparation, execution, and isolation helpers were deleted while live callers remain.
  WHY: Brokered phases fail with `model_provider_broker_start: command not found`, and the credential-isolation boundary has no replacement.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 493-498, 947-1352 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` and the `review_blocked_*` helper family were deleted while judge and orchestration callers remain.
  WHY: Authenticated judge-fix pushes and review-blocked approval, successor, and terminal-decision flows cannot execute.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 732-738, 766-772, 833-839, 893-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: REST and GraphQL PR-comment normalization dropped `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked producer binding and approver authorization cannot identify trusted comments from the normalized payload.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 55-57,62-68 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `codex_config_assemble` removed the `--provider-base-url` option.
  WHY: Existing callers terminate with `unknown argument: --provider-base-url` before configuration is produced.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: lines 29-35, 85-90, 95-100, 105-110, 143-148, 258-264 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` parsing was removed and `base_url` is hard-coded to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`.
  WHY: Callers fail on the unknown option, while surviving paths bypass the loopback broker and use the public provider endpoint.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 4-15, 49-54, 127-132 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` was removed while `review_apply_fixes.sh` still passes it.
  WHY: The stall guard exits on an unknown option before launching the editor, and the process-group cleanup contract is unavailable.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 165-462 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Process-group identity capture, privileged termination, and survivor verification were removed and replaced with simpler child polling and killing.
  WHY: Isolated editor descendants can survive cleanup with workspace access without being verified or terminated.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 98-237 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block is gated on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` or `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, but no workflow exports either variable.
  WHY: The regression protection is unreachable, so self-repo implement runs can again overwrite branch-owned helper edits with staged support copies.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 30-37 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module imports deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and `is_sensitive_target_path` symbols.
  WHY: Test collection raises `ImportError` before the targeted-context tests run.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 536-716 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file, binary, overflow, header, and summary markers do not advance `used_bytes`, and the path-count cap was removed.
  WHY: Large untrusted path lists can exceed `max_bytes` and the model context budget by an unbounded amount.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 244-247, 596 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Once `semble_overflow_budget_exhausted` becomes true, later paths skip Semble retrieval even when they would fit.
  WHY: One oversized file disables semantic retrieval for all subsequent files.

- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh: lines 8-77 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Empty or transient `gh issue view` results are treated as latch verification failures without bounded retry or an inconclusive state.
  WHY: The script can report a false-negative latch status and permit redundant escalation or redispatch races.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 68-82, 479-480 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication variables exported in the configuration step do not persist into later memory-operation steps.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, later `memory_ensure_branch` Git commands have no authentication.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 203-205 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `git merge-file` receives the files in an order the reviewer identifies as inconsistent with the stated rebase intent.
  WHY: The reviewer reports that using the wrong common ancestor can drop branch changes or create spurious conflicts; moonshotai_kimi-k3 explicitly verified this as a false positive and states that `git merge-file current base other` with current=editor, base=installed copy, other=HEAD is correct.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: lines 47-49, 98-100, 146-149, 212-222, 233-241, 400-417, 441-449, 665-671 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Sibling helper resolution changed to an absolute `BASH_SOURCE`-derived directory while consumers may expect helpers under `scripts/`.
  WHY: Consumer repositories that previously sourced the same path may fail to locate helpers, in addition to losing the broker boundary.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 86-138 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The helper-install loop no longer sets `MEMORY_HELPERS_READY=0` when installation fails.
  WHY: The current path exits immediately, but future permissive failure handling could leave downstream steps believing the helper set is ready.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 158-160, 184-186 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Temporary files created by the staged-support block have no EXIT-trap cleanup.
  WHY: Interrupted or failed runs can accumulate temporary files and consume bounded runner temporary storage.
